title: Budgeting by phase

D0.outcome: Explains that the three phases need different amounts of thought and why.

D1.outcome: Writes a phase budget for a given time control and says where the critical decisions usually fall.

D2.outcome: Plays ten games with the phase budget and the log shows the allocation follows the budget.

D3.outcome: Adjusts the phase budget to the opening he plays and the games he meets.

misconceptions: The opening needs no time because it is known.
conditions: Phase boundaries are identified from the log, not guessed.
contrasts: The same budget for opening and critical middlegame.
A phase budget that ignores the learner's own opening.
A game decided by a tactic in the first ten moves.
